stem: A 2 kg body moving at 3 m/s is brought to rest without rotation or a change in potential energy; what is the net work done on the body and the positive energy transferred out?

options.text: −9 J of net work on the body; 9 J transferred out
9 J of net work on the body; 9 J transferred out
−6 J of net work on the body; 6 J transferred out
−18 J of net work on the body; 18 J transferred out

assumptions: Treat the body as a translating rigid mass in an inertial frame; all net work is accounted for.
